publication_policy: Assignments may be drafted locally, but each article must pass the CREN article gate with current fetched sources before publication.

assignments.reader_job: Help relocators and move-up buyers decide whether Dublin fits budget, school/context needs, commute, taxes, and family routine.
assignments.angle: Dublin is a premium-suburb decision; the useful consumer question is total household fit versus nearby substitutes, not a generic best-suburb claim.

original_reporting_tasks: Verify current Dublin city, township, and school-attendance caveats before publication.
Compare Dublin against Hilliard, Worthington, Westerville, Powell, and New Albany without ranking them.
Spot-check current housing examples by price band and label them as temporary reporting notes.
Identify one current planning, roadway, or development issue only if dated city documentation supports it.
claim_source_notes: Use the city plan for policy direction only; do not turn planning goals into proof of future value or demand.
Use Dublin City Schools only for boundary and verification language; do not make school-quality recommendations.
Use Columbus REALTORS for dated market context only after refreshing the latest monthly report.
Any commute claim needs a dated map check or reader-framed commute anchor rather than a universal travel-time promise.
data_refresh_notes: DATA_REFRESH_REQUIRED before publication: latest monthly housing report, current active-listing examples, tax page status, and school-boundary lookup language.
publish_blocks: Do not make school-quality conclusions without source labeling.
Do not make address-level boundary claims without exact parcel and school-locator verification.
Do not present premium-suburb demand as a guaranteed seller outcome.
Do not publish live price statements without a dated market refresh.
